assets.name: courtyard
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original architectural photograph for fictional ARCOS studio, full-width website hero. Create ONE ultra-realistic horizontal 3:2 architectural editorial photograph, not a website mockup. Subject: a modest, sophisticated single-storey U-shaped courtyard house on an Attica hillside, designed around one mature olive tree. Three rectilinear wings: a long rear wing and two side wings enclosing an open gravel courtyard toward camera. Flat thin parapets, rough pale local limestone walls, warm chalk limewash, deep rectangular openings with dark bronze slim window frames, honey oak shutters. The left wing contains the living room behind a floor-to-ceiling glass opening, the right wing two quiet bedrooms with smaller deep openings. The rear wing has shaded glazed kitchen/dining. View from slightly elevated human eye level outside the open south side looking north across courtyard. Dry grasses, rubble-stone retaining edge, quiet grey-green olive groves and low mountains. Unstyled lived-in realism, a simple timber chair, minimal objects, small construction imperfections, believable material grain, no people. Cloud-filtered late afternoon Mediterranean light, precise soft-edged shadows, natural neutral colours, not orange sunset. Editorial architecture magazine photograph, 35mm tilt-shift lens, corrected verticals, gentle film grain, wide composition with building and courtyard fully in view. No swimming pool, no curved sci-fi forms, no luxury hotel, no excessive landscaping, no text, no logos, no watermark, no collage.

assets.name: interior
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: second view of the SAME fictional ARCOS courtyard house. Reference image is the architectural identity, materials, proportions and lighting, not an edit target. Create a horizontal 3:2 architectural editorial photograph from inside the living room in the LEFT wing looking across the same gravel courtyard to the right wing and olive tree. Preserve the restrained rough pale limestone exterior, chalk limewash, dark bronze glazing and honey oak joinery. A low oatmeal linen sofa partially visible in foreground, one plain oak table with a closed book, limestone floor with believable fine joints, massive deep rectangular window reveal frames olive leaves and courtyard. Eye height 1.4m, 40mm tilt-shift architectural lens, straight verticals. Quiet asymmetric composition, subtle exposure difference between shade and daylight, fine material pores, non-repeating wood grain. No people, no random sculptures, no vases everywhere, no lush indoor plants, no text, no collages, no pool, no additional floors. Refined but lived in. Same neutral Mediterranean late afternoon light, not gold filter. It should convincingly belong to the house in the reference.

assets.name: detail
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: architectural material detail photograph for fictional ARCOS courtyard house. Use the attached house as the materials reference. ONE horizontal 3:2 close-up photograph, filling the image with the joint where rough pale warm-grey limestone blocks at left meet a deep chalk limewash reveal in the middle, a slender dark bronze door track and vertical-grained honey oak sliding shutter at right, limestone threshold along bottom. Same house, same materials, soft raking daylight. Tactile, sophisticated construction detail, real mortar and stone pores, restrained imperfect surfaces, subtle grain in timber, no polished marble. Composition is an abstract but readable architectural junction, vertical lines, slight three-quarter depth, sharp details, neutral white balance, photographed on a 65mm architectural lens. No text, people, logos, plants, invented objects, watermarks or collage. Enough resolution for an interactive magnifying lens.

assets.name: tour-living
assets.prompt:
Create a photorealistic architectural 360 degree EQUIRECTANGULAR PANORAMA texture, exact 2:1 aspect ratio, 360 degrees horizontal by 180 degrees vertical, highest available resolution. This is a projection texture for an interactive panorama viewer, NOT a normal wide-angle photo, NOT a collage or multiple panels. Straight vertical lines remain vertical; ceiling at the zenith, floor at the nadir; horizontal lines curve according to spherical equirectangular projection. Left and right edges must join seamlessly. No borders, no text, no people.
Use the attached interior and exterior as material and architectural references for the SAME fictional single-storey U-shaped Greek courtyard house: pale rough limestone outside, chalk limewash inside, honey oak, slim dark bronze openings, warm limestone floor. Camera at standing eye height at the centre of the rectangular living space in the west wing, not in a corner. On the central 90-degree portion of the panorama, a wide open east-facing bronze sliding glass opening shows the gravel courtyard and ONE mature olive tree, with the low stone sleeping wing beyond. To the north (quarter left of centre) a generous open passage leads towards the rear kitchen/dining wing, with an oak dining table glimpsed. Behind the camera, at far left/right seam, an uninterrupted limewashed wall with one small abstract artwork. South wall (quarter right of centre) has a deep-set window looking to dry Greek hills. Low ivory linen sofa along the west wall, one low oak coffee table with two books, natural woven rug, restrained lived-in details. Rectangular simple architecture, coherent furniture and structural joins, no warped impossible doors, no extra archways, no islands floating outdoors. Late afternoon soft sun from courtyard, restrained editorial architecture photography, realistic irregular limestone and subtle plaster texture. Preserve warm neutral palette and understated quality of references. Essential: entire spherical environment in a seamless 2:1 equirectangular texture suitable for looking around from ONE FIXED camera position, including ceiling and floor.
assets.usage: Partial panoramic concept view, 1774×887, WebP quality 91. Original generated sphere was visually unsuitable for full 360°; constrained to a 180×90 field in Pannellum.

assets.name: tour-courtyard
assets.prompt: Generate a seamless EQUIRECTANGULAR panorama texture for a virtual architectural tour, exact 2:1 aspect ratio, 360 horizontal x180 vertical degrees. Highest possible resolution. One fixed eye-level camera in the middle of an open gravel courtyard next to a mature olive tree. Same fictional Greek Courtyard House as supplied reference: U-shaped SINGLE STOREY, rough pale limestone, flat roofs, slim dark bronze glass openings, honey oak shutters, ivory limewashed interiors. Central direction looks WEST directly into the living wing: large glass sliding opening, ivory linen sofa, oak coffee table, quiet plaster interior. LEFT side of texture looks SOUTH towards the open end of the U and dry Greek hillside landscape. RIGHT side shows the NORTH rear dining/kitchen wing, broad open glass, oak dining table. Far LEFT and RIGHT seam is EAST sleeping wing, continuous pale limestone wall with a simple oak shutter; edges join perfectly. No duplicate olive trees: one tree just out of centre to right, with small circle of stone edging at trunk. Sky fills upper hemisphere, gravel fills lower hemisphere, equirectangular pole distortion at top and bottom, vertical building edges remain vertical, horizontal features curve appropriately. Do not draw a conventional wide-angle perspective or collage. No people, no text, no border, no dramatic effects. Editorial architectural photography, soft late afternoon sunlight, realistic limestone texture and olive leaves, restrained neutrals matching the reference. A clean and consistent visualisation of the SAME architecture, not a different luxury villa. Panoramic projection from one position only.
